description: Curated multi-skill bundles derived from the AutoForge catalog. Used by tools_catalog.py route and tools_plan.py workflow.
selection_rule: Use a recipe only when at least two meaningful goal words match; otherwise fall back to catalog search (skills 1-198).

patterns.name: Nightly invoice intake and approval
patterns.summary: Scheduled folder intake, OCR extraction, validation, invoice checks, approval routing, audit log and regression tests.
patterns.notes: Financial impact: totals and duplicates must be validated and reviewed before posting to any accounting system.

patterns.name: Scheduled data report and distribution
patterns.summary: Pull or transform data, validate it, render a report, and deliver it to named recipients on a schedule.
patterns.notes: Delivery to external recipients needs an explicit recipient allowlist and a preview step.

patterns.name: Folder intake, classification and routing
patterns.summary: Watch a folder, classify and validate incoming files, route them to the right place, and record what happened.
patterns.notes: Never delete rejected files; quarantine them with an audit entry.

patterns.name: Website and service monitoring with escalation
patterns.summary: Probe sites or services, deduplicate noisy alerts, escalate by severity, and build an incident timeline.
patterns.notes: Probes are read-only; keep request rate bounded and respect target terms of service.

patterns.name: Data collection to refreshed dashboard
patterns.summary: Collect approved public or API data, record provenance, clean it, validate it, and refresh a dashboard.
patterns.notes: Respect robots.txt, rate limits, licensing and terms of service; no authenticated scraping without written approval.

patterns.name: Two-system API integration with rate control
patterns.summary: Build signed API calls, map schemas, control rate limits, verify the contract, and sync offline changes.
patterns.notes: Credentials must come from environment or a vault reference; never inline them in generated code.

patterns.name: CI build, test and release pipeline
patterns.summary: Scaffold, build, test, gate code quality, generate release notes, and release with change control.
patterns.notes: Production release steps require an approval record; keep artifacts immutable.

patterns.name: Employee onboarding orchestration
patterns.summary: Provision access and devices through an approval workflow, then track completion and conversation handoff.
patterns.notes: Granting access is privileged: least privilege, approval, and a revoke path are mandatory.

patterns.name: Reviewed bulk file cleanup and declutter
patterns.summary: Find duplicates and stale files, preview the change set, checkpoint, then move to a recoverable trash area.
patterns.notes: Destructive: default to a reversible quarantine folder, require a preview diff and a named approver.

patterns.name: Reviewed content publishing across channels
patterns.summary: Prepare, check brand compliance, adapt for channels, and publish only after approval.
patterns.notes: Public action: every post needs human approval and a takedown plan.

patterns.name: Bot build, evaluation and deployment packaging
patterns.summary: Build a scoped bot, bind approved tools, test refusals and recovery, then package prompts, config and tests.
patterns.notes: Bots must have a documented refusal policy and a human handoff path.

patterns.name: Cloud drift detection and safe recovery
patterns.summary: Detect infrastructure drift, inventory resources, run narrow approved recovery, and keep a rollback path.
patterns.notes: Any mutating infrastructure action needs a plan/diff, a checkpoint, and bounded retries.

patterns.name: Document intake to searchable knowledge base
patterns.summary: Ingest PDFs and scans, OCR, extract metadata, validate, and update a knowledge base index.
patterns.notes: Respect document retention and access rules; index only approved collections.

patterns.name: Personal capture to task routing
patterns.summary: Turn inbox items and saved links into tasks or a reading queue, with reminders and a routine schedule.
patterns.notes: Personal data stays local by default; never forward private items to external services without consent.
